# Best noise-cancelling earbuds under $150

The sources I found don't give direct purchase links for most of these, so I've linked the review or roundup page that lists each one. Prices change often, so check them before buying.

## My top picks

**1. Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro: best overall value**
- It has adaptive ANC, LDAC, multipoint, wireless charging and IPX5 water resistance. It lists at $149.99, and a Dealectric listing says code AFSC20 brings it to about $120 at Soundcore's store. They report testing the code on 2026-10-22, and it expires 2026-12-31.
- SoundGuys rated it 8.2/10, with ANC that beat 63% of the earbuds it measured. It's an older model, since the Liberty 5 Pro ($169.99) is over budget.
- [Buy link (affiliate)](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-liberty-4-pro) · [Dealectric details](https://dealectric.com/answers/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-under-150-2026-reviews-prices) · [iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/)

**2. Nothing Ear (3): strongest ANC under $150**
- iTech Level cites SoundGuys scoring its ANC 8.2/10. It has LDAC, multipoint and wireless charging.
- SlashGear says it comes "just barely under $150" on Amazon.
- Downsides are bass-heavy tuning, muffled call mics and about 5 hours of battery with ANC on.
- [iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/) · [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)

**3. Samsung Galaxy Buds3 Pro: best for Android, especially Samsung**
- SlashGear says a new pair from Samsung's official Amazon store was $134. They have great adaptive ANC, IPX7 and up to 18 hours of battery with the case.
- [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)

**4. Sony WF-C710N: best Sony pick**
- What Hi-Fi? names it its best budget pick at $119 at Walmart, $128 at Best Buy.
- A third review site, Sound Mavericks, lists 8.5 hours of battery with ANC on and Sony's Adaptive Sound Control. It lacks LDAC.
- [What Hi-Fi?](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-the-true-wireless-way-to-cut-out-background-noise) · [Sound Mavericks](https://soundmavericks.com/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-under-150/)

## Other options
- **AirPods Pro 2 (iPhone users):** SlashGear says renewed pairs sell for just under $150 on sale. They have excellent ANC and transparency mode, but Apple no longer sells them new. The newer AirPods Pro 3 are $179 at Amazon, which is over budget ([What Hi-Fi?](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-the-true-wireless-way-to-cut-out-background-noise)). The new AirPods 5 ($129, or $149 with wireless charging) have open-fit ANC, which blocks less noise than sealed buds ([iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/)).
- **Soundcore Space A40:** RTINGS' budget pick. It has adaptive ANC that matches many pricier buds, but poor call mics. I didn't see a current price ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-earbuds)).
- **Soundcore P31i ($59.99):** The cheapest option. It has adaptive ANC and a 4.4-star Amazon average over 8,000+ reviews, though its ANC isn't class-leading ([SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)).
- **EarFun Air Pro 4:** Sound Mavericks ranks it #1, but its scores are less rigorous and I saw no price, so verify it first ([Sound Mavericks](https://soundmavericks.com/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-under-150/)).

## Which to choose
- **iPhone:** AirPods Pro 2 (renewed, on sale) or Liberty 4 Pro.
- **Android or Samsung:** Galaxy Buds3 Pro, or Nothing Ear (3) for the strongest ANC.
- **Best value:** Liberty 4 Pro with the discount code.
- **Tightest budget:** Soundcore P31i or Sony WF-C710N.

If you want the best ANC regardless of price, Tom's Guide and What Hi-Fi? pick the Bose QuietComfort Ultra Earbuds (2nd Gen) at $299, well over your budget.

Dealectric's buy link is an affiliate link.
